Description
Queen's University Belfast located in Northern Ireland and received its charter in 1845. Queen's is a member of the Russell Group of research intensive universities. The university has a rich heritage and a renowned history of producing Nobel Laureates, leading global academics and national and international leaders over the last 170 years.
It is ranked #209 in QS Global World Rankings 2021.
